string.text: The server's name in the lists of games (15\ncharacters). Enter changes it.
Players must type it to join; NONE for an open\nserver. Enter sets it.
PUBLIC: listed in everyone's server browser.\nPRIVATE: joined on the LAN or by its invite.
The most players the server takes.
Players in the lobby before it counts down to the\nnext round.
Seconds the lobby counts down once enough players\nare in.
Players who join without a Custom Edition map\ndownload it from the server.
The most the server sends of maps, so that the\ngame keeps the rest of the upload.
Players can vote to kick a player from the server.
A notice each player is shown on joining; NONE\nfor none. Enter sets it.
